claims.claim_text: Teradyne reported $3,190.0 million in total revenue for fiscal year 2025, split across Semiconductor Test ($2,358.6M = SOC $1,889.7M + Memory $504.9M + IST not broken out separately), Robotics ($308.3M), and Product Test ($357.9M, plus IST $129.2M).
claims.subject: Teradyne

claims.claim_text: On January 29, 2026, Teradyne announced an agreement to form a joint venture, MultiLane Test Products (MLTP), with MultiLane to serve the AI Data Center equipment market. Teradyne will invest approximately $157 million for 75% ownership, expected to close in 1H 2026.
claims.subject: Teradyne / MultiLane
claims.source_quote: On January 29, 2026 , Teradyne and MultiLane ... announced an agreement to form a joint venture, MultiLane Test Products ( MLTP ) ... Teradyne will invest in approximately $ 157 million in exchange for 75 % ownership of MLTP .

claims.claim_text: On May 27, 2024, Teradyne purchased a 10% equity stake in Technoprobe S.p.A. for 483.1 million Euros ($524.1M). As of Dec 31, 2025, carrying value $537.1M; fair value of publicly traded shares $935.7M.
claims.subject: Teradyne
claims.source_quote: On May 27, 2024, Teradyne paid 483.1 million Euros, equivalent to $ 524.1 million, to purchase ... 10 % of the issued and outstanding shares of Technoprobe.

claims.claim_text: Teradyne acquired Quantifi Photonics (PIC test solutions) on May 31, 2025 for $127.2M, included in Product Test segment.
claims.subject: Teradyne
claims.source_quote: On May 31, 2025, we acquired privately held Quantifi Photonics ( Quantifi ), a leader in PIC test solutions for a total purchase price of $ 127.2 million.

claims.claim_text: Teradyne acquired Infineon's automated test equipment technology and team (AET) based in Regensburg, Germany on January 31, 2025 for 17.6M Euros ($18.3M).
claims.subject: Teradyne
claims.source_quote: On January 31, 2025, we acquired Infineon Technologies AG's ( Infineon ) automated test equipment technology and associated development team ( AET ) based in Regensburg, Germany for a total purchase price of 17.6 million Euros, equivalent to $ 18.3 million.

claims.claim_text: Teradyne Robotics segment underwent restructuring impacting approximately 400 employees in 2025, recording $24.3M of severance charges related to Robotics out of $29.4M total severance for the year.
claims.subject: Teradyne Robotics (UR/MiR)
claims.source_quote: Teradyne recorded $ 29.4 million of severance charges, $ 24.3 million of which is related to the Robotics restructuring which impacted approximately 400 employees

claims.claim_text: Teradyne's Robotics segment achieved third consecutive quarter of sequential revenue growth in Q4 2025; full-year Robotics revenue $308.3M (vs $364.8M in 2024 = decline of ~15.5% YoY).
claims.subject: Teradyne Robotics
claims.object_value: $308.3M FY2025 (down from $364.8M FY2024); Q4 2025 third consecutive quarter sequential growth
claims.source_quote: In our Robotics segment, the fourth quarter of 2025 represented the third consecutive quarter of sequential revenue growth.

claims.claim_text: Teradyne returned $778.4M to shareholders in 2025 through $702.1M of share buybacks and $76.3M of dividend payments. Net income for FY2025 was $554.0M ($3.47 diluted EPS).
claims.subject: Teradyne
claims.source_quote: During 2025, we ... returned $778.4 million to shareholders through $702.1 million of share buybacks and $76.3 million of dividend payments.

claims.claim_text: Teradyne holds patents in robotics (collaborative arms / autonomous mobile robots via Universal Robots and MiR subsidiaries) and semiconductor test technology.
claims.subject: Teradyne
claims.source_quote: Teradyne's robotics product offerings consist primarily of collaborative robotic arms and autonomous mobile robots used by global manufacturing, logistics and industrial customers
